entries.statement: Erdős–Straus Conjecture: 4/n = 1/a+1/b+1/c solvable for all n≥2.
Prime k-tuples (Hardy–Littlewood): Asymptotics for admissible prime constellations.
Infinitude of Wilson Primes: Are there infinitely many Wilson primes?
Infinitude of Repunit Primes: Are there infinitely many repunit primes?
Brocard's Problem: n!+1 = m² has only finitely many solutions (Brown numbers).
Fortune's Conjecture: The 'fortunate numbers' are always prime.
Infinitude of Mersenne Primes: Are there infinitely many primes 2^p − 1?
Giuga's Conjecture: Σ k^{n−1} ≡ −1 (mod n) iff n is prime.
Finiteness of Fermat Primes: Are only finitely many Fermat numbers 2^(2^n)+1 prime?
Goldbach's Conjecture: Every even integer > 2 is a sum of two primes.
Infinitude of Sophie Germain Primes: Infinitely many primes p with 2p+1 prime.
Riesel Problem: Is 509203 the smallest Riesel number?
Polignac's Conjecture: For every even k, infinitely many prime pairs differ by k.
Twin Prime Conjecture: There are infinitely many primes p with p+2 prime.
Infinitude of Amicable Pairs: Are there infinitely many amicable number pairs?
Oppermann's Conjecture: Prime-counting bounds between n(n−1), n², n(n+1).
Sierpiński Problem: Is 78557 the smallest Sierpiński number?
Landau's n²+1 Problem: There are infinitely many primes of the form n²+1.
Three-Prime Carmichael Infinitude: Infinitely many Carmichael numbers with three prime factors.
Infinitude of Palindromic Primes: Infinitely many palindromic primes (in base 10).
Gilbreath's Conjecture: Iterated absolute prime-gap differences all begin with 1.
Legendre's Conjecture: There is always a prime between n² and (n+1)².
Infinitude of Even Perfect Numbers: Are there infinitely many (even) perfect numbers?
Collatz Conjecture: Iterating n→n/2 (even) or 3n+1 (odd) always reaches 1.

Sum of the Reciprocals of the Triangular Numbers
Liouville's Theorem and the Construction of Transcendental Numbers
Euler's Generalization of Fermat's Little Theorem
The Solution of the General Quartic Equation
Insolvability of General Higher Degree Equations
Negation on ZMod 5 realizes the reflection element of D5 acting on the vertex pentagon: the map n ↦ -n is the automorphism of C5 corresponding to a reflection under Aut(C5) ≅ DihedralGroup 5.
5 is the unique prime congruent to 0 mod 5; every prime p > 5 has residue in {1,2,3,4} mod 5.

All Primes (1 mod 4) Equal the Sum of Two Squares
Sum of the Angles of a Triangle
Divergence of the Prime Reciprocal Series
The Independence of the Parallel Postulate
The Irrationality of the Square Root of 2
Formula for the Number of Combinations
The Undecidability of the Continuum Hypothesis
The offset pattern {p_i − p_1 : i ≤ 9} ∪ {0} for the first nine primes covers both residues mod 2, hence is inadmissible: it has at most one prime translate.
Lehmer's Mahler-Measure Conjecture: A gap above 1 in Mahler measures of integer polynomials.
Moving Sofa Problem: Largest area of a shape moved around an L-corridor.
Schanuel's Conjecture: A transcendence-degree lower bound for exp of ℚ-linearly-independent numbers.
Beal's Conjecture: A^x+B^y=C^z with x,y,z>2 forces a common factor.
Dixmier Conjecture: Every endomorphism of the Weyl algebra A_n is an automorphism.
3×3 Magic Square of Squares: Does a 3×3 magic square of distinct perfect squares exist?
Exponential Time Hypothesis: 3-SAT has no 2^{o(n)} algorithm.
Perfect Cuboid (Euler Brick): Does a box with integer edges, face- and space-diagonals exist?
Invariant Subspace Problem: Does every bounded operator on a separable Hilbert space have a nontrivial invariant subspace?
Waring–Goldbach Problems: Representations by sums of prime powers.
Lehmer's Totient Problem: Does φ(n) | n−1 imply n prime?
Hadwiger Conjecture: A K_t-minor-free graph is (t−1)-colorable.
Cramér's Conjecture: Prime gaps satisfy g_n = O((log p_n)²).
Navier–Stokes Existence & Smoothness: Do smooth solutions of the 3D Navier–Stokes equations always exist?
Various Erdős Conjectures: Erdős's large family of prize problems.
Nagata's Conjecture: A lower bound on degrees of curves through general points.
Jacobian Conjecture: A polynomial map with constant nonzero Jacobian is invertible.
Inscribed Square (Toeplitz) Problem: Does every Jordan curve contain four vertices of a square?
Baum–Connes Conjecture: An isomorphism computing K-theory of group C*-algebras.
Lonely Runner Conjecture: On a unit circle each runner is eventually 'lonely'.
Zaremba's Conjecture: Every denominator has a continued fraction with bounded partial quotients.
Smooth 4-Dimensional Poincaré: Is every smooth homotopy 4-sphere diffeomorphic to S⁴?
Sunflower Conjecture: Bounds forcing a sunflower (Δ-system).
Gauss Class Number Problem: Are there infinitely many real quadratic fields of class number 1?
Unique Games Conjecture: Hardness of approximating unique label-cover.
Grimm's Conjecture: Distinct prime divisors can be assigned to consecutive composites.
Union-Closed Sets (Frankl): Some element lies in ≥ half the sets of a union-closed family.
Bombieri–Lang Conjecture: Rational points on general-type varieties are non-Zariski-dense.
Leopoldt's Conjecture: The p-adic regulator of a number field is nonzero.
Ryser's Conjecture: Covering number ≤ (r−1)·matching number in r-partite hypergraphs.
Yau's Conjectures (various): A family of open conjectures in geometric analysis.
Caccetta–Häggkvist Conjecture: Minimum out-degree forces a short directed cycle.
Yang–Mills Existence & Mass Gap: Construct quantum Yang–Mills theory with a positive mass gap.
Grothendieck Standard Conjectures: Structural conjectures on algebraic cycles and motives.
Greenberg's Conjecture: Iwasawa λ,μ invariants vanish for totally real fields.
Existence of NP-Intermediate Problems: Problems in NP that are neither in P nor NP-complete (if P≠NP).
Diagonal Ramsey Exponent: Improve the base in R(k,k) growth.
1/3–2/3 Conjecture: Every finite non-total poset has a pair with comparison probability in [1/3,2/3].
Hadwiger–Nelson Problem: Chromatic number of the plane (unit-distance graph).
Ramsey Number R(5,5): Determine R(5,5) (known to lie in [43,46]).
Firoozbakht's Conjecture: p_n^(1/n) is strictly decreasing.
Littlewood Conjecture: liminf n·‖nα‖·‖nβ‖ = 0 for all reals α,β.
Sendov's Conjecture: Near each root of a polynomial (roots in unit disk) lies a critical point.
Casas-Alvero Conjecture: A degree-n polynomial sharing a root with each derivative is (x−a)^n.
Grothendieck's Section Conjecture: Rational points via sections of the étale fundamental group.
Tate Conjecture: Étale cohomology classes fixed by Galois are algebraic.
Erdős–Turán (density) Conjecture: Sets with divergent reciprocal sum contain arbitrarily long APs.
Riemann Hypothesis: All nontrivial zeros of ζ(s) have real part 1/2.
Vandiver's Conjecture: p does not divide the class number of the real cyclotomic field.
Hodge Conjecture: Certain de Rham cohomology classes on projective varieties are algebraic.
Hilbert's 16th Problem: Bounds on the number/position of limit cycles of planar polynomial vector fields.
Singmaster's Conjecture: Each n>1 appears a bounded number of times in Pascal's triangle.
Odd Perfect Number: Does an odd perfect number exist?
P versus NP: Is every problem whose solution is quickly verifiable also quickly solvable?
Birch & Swinnerton-Dyer Conjecture: Rank of an elliptic curve equals the order of vanishing of its L-function at s=1.
Novikov Conjecture: Higher signatures are homotopy invariants.
